text: DSH Codex Timeline 是面向 DSH Web 的轮次导航增强插件。它在会话头部操作区接入搜索与收藏面板，并沿用官方轮次导航显示可定制的时间线。用户可以搜索当前会话的历史轮次、跳转到匹配内容、收藏常用轮次、预览轮次摘要与时间和 Token 指标，也可以从已完成轮次创建分支，并调整导航位置和间距。适合需要在长对话中定位内容、管理常用轮次或基于旧轮次继续探索的 DSH Web 用户。需要兼容版本的 DSH Web 宿主服务，不需要额外 API 密钥；偏好保存在 DSH profile 设置中。

DSH Codex Timeline enhances DSH Web turn navigation with session search, favorites, turn previews, branching, and layout controls. It helps users find and revisit useful turns in long conversations. It requires compatible DSH host services, but no API key; preferences are saved in profile settings.

DSH Codex Timeline 的功能「会话全文搜索」：在当前会话的搜索面板输入关键词，插件读取会话轮次并返回匹配摘要；选择结果可定位到对应轮次。
DSH Codex Timeline 的功能「收藏与筛选」：在搜索结果或轮次预览中点选星标保存常用轮次，再启用收藏筛选即可只显示收藏内容。
DSH Codex Timeline 的功能「轮次预览与分支」：悬停轮次可查看摘要、回答、状态、时间和 Token 指标；对可分支的已完成轮次执行分支操作，会通过 DSH 工作区打开新会话。
DSH Codex Timeline 的功能「导航布局偏好」：在设置中的 Timeline 面板启用或关闭增强，并选择左右位置、边距、纵向偏移、标记间距和最近轮次数量。

DSH Codex Timeline 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 的轮次导航增强插件。`0.6.4` 针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` 的虚拟化导航增加显示适配层，恢复短横渐变、左右布局、自定义间距和收藏筛选。会话内容、历史加载及分支仍调用官方接口；关闭增强后恢复官方导航。

dsh-codex-timeline README · DSH Codex Timeline：插件只补充官方导航目前没有的能力：完整会话搜索、收藏、从指定轮次分支、包含时间与 Token 消耗的轮次预览，以及原有的个性化布局选项。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> `0.6.4` 适配 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`；DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3` 请继续使用插件 `0.6.0`。

dsh-codex-timeline README · 功能：- 增强 DSH 原生轮次导航，提供阶梯波浪和高亮动效。
- 收藏常用轮次，并可在导航栏中只查看收藏内容。
- 搜索完整会话，快速定位并跳转到目标轮次。
- 查看轮次内容、时间和 Token 信息预览。
- 从已完成的轮次创建新分支。
- 自定义导航栏左右位置、边距、纵向偏移、标记间距和显示数量。

dsh-codex-timeline README · 兼容性：DSH 从 `0.1.2` 系列开始内置原生轮次导航栏。`0.6.4` 为新版虚拟化导航提供显示适配层，保留插件的搜索、收藏、分支、预览、阶梯波浪和个性化布局；会话数据和历史加载仍由 DSH 管理。

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`、`0.1.7-rc.1` / `0.1.7-rc.2`：使用插件 `0.6.4`。
- DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3`：使用插件 `0.6.0`。
- 此前版本的 DSH：使用旧版插件 `0.5.5`，由该版本提供完整的独立时间线。

旧版插件可以通过 npm 指定版本安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-codex-timeline@0.5.5"
```

也可以下载 [`v0.5.5` 源码包](https://github.com/Wine-Red/dsh-codex-timeline/archive/refs/tags/v0.5.5.zip)。当前主分支的 `install.ps1` 接受上表中的 `0.1.7` 与 `0.2.0` 版本，不用于安装旧版插件。

dsh-codex-timeline README · 安装：> npm 与 GitHub Release 提供预构建发布包；安装后重启 DSH。桌面端可在插件管理中安装包名，CLI 用户使用实际 profile 名称（例如 `web` 或 `desktop`）。

以下步骤适用于 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` 及上表中的 `0.1.7` 版本。更早的 DSH 请按兼容表安装指定的旧版插件。

先确认本机版本：

```powershell
dsh --version
```

安装 npm 发布包：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-codex-timeline@0.6.4
```

本地开发时可以直接链接当前目录：

```powershell
.\install.ps1 -Profile web -Source "E:\Program\DSH_plugin\dsh-codex-timeline"
```

安装后重启 DSH Web 并刷新浏览器。设置位于“设置 → 内置插件 → Timeline”。
dsh-codex-timeline README · 隐私：完整历史搜索通过同源 Host 路由 `/codex-timeline/search` 读取当前会话记录，只返回轮次摘要、有限上下文和本地日志已有的时间/Token 指标。搜索内容、收藏与交互状态不会发送给模型、遥测服务或第三方。

dsh-codex-timeline README · 开发与验证：```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm run check
pnpm pack --pack-destination artifacts
```

`scripts/verify-dist.mjs` 会阻止旧 Conversation 副本、自建导航座位、Portal、私有运行时依赖或本机路径重新进入发布包，并验证 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 的插槽、会话 API、设置和分支锚点契约。

dsh-codex-timeline README · DSH Codex Timeline：DSH Codex Timeline enhances turn navigation in DeepSeek Harness Web. Version `0.6.4` adds a presentation adapter for the virtualized rail in DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`, restoring the hover gradient, left/right placement, marker spacing, and favorite filtering. Session loading and branching use official APIs. Disabling enhancements restores the official rail.

dsh-codex-timeline README · DSH Codex Timeline：The plugin adds the capabilities the official navigator does not yet provide: complete-session search, favorites, branching from a selected Turn, a time-and-token-rich Turn preview, and the existing personalization controls.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Plugin `0.6.4` supports DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`. Keep `0.6.0` for DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3`.

dsh-codex-timeline README · Features：- Enhances DSH's native turn navigator with a staircase wave and highlight motion.
- Saves favorite Turns and filters the navigator to favorites.
- Searches the complete conversation and jumps directly to a selected Turn.
- Previews Turn content, time, and token information.
- Creates a new branch from a completed Turn.
- Customizes the navigator side, offsets, marker spacing, and number of visible Turns.

dsh-codex-timeline README · Compatibility：DSH introduced a native turn navigator in the `0.1.2` series. Since `0.6.0`, this plugin enhances that native navigator with search, favorites, branching, previews, staircase motion, and layout customization instead of creating a separate timeline.

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.1` / `0.1.7-rc.2`: use plugin `0.6.4`.
- DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3`: use plugin `0.6.0`.
- Earlier DSH releases: use plugin `0.5.5`, which provides the complete standalone timeline.

dsh-codex-timeline README · Compatibility：Install the legacy plugin by specifying its npm version:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-codex-timeline@0.5.5"
```

You can also download the [`v0.5.5` source archive](https://github.com/Wine-Red/dsh-codex-timeline/archive/refs/tags/v0.5.5.zip). The current `install.ps1` accepts the `0.1.7` and `0.2.0` versions listed above; do not use it to install the legacy plugin.

dsh-codex-timeline README · Installation：> Prebuilt packages are available from npm and GitHub Releases. Restart DSH after installation. Desktop users can install the package name through plugin management; CLI users should select their actual profile, such as `web` or `desktop`.

The following steps apply to DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` and the `0.1.7` versions listed above. For earlier DSH releases, select the legacy plugin version from the compatibility list.

Confirm the installed runtime first:

```powershell
dsh --version
```

dsh-codex-timeline README · Installation：Install the npm release:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-codex-timeline@0.6.4
```

For local development, link this checkout directly:

```powershell
.\install.ps1 -Profile web -Source "E:\Program\DSH_plugin\dsh-codex-timeline"
```

Restart DSH Web and refresh the browser. Preferences live under Settings → Built-in plugins → Timeline.

dsh-codex-timeline README · Privacy：Complete-history search reads the current conversation through the same-origin Host route `/codex-timeline/search` and returns only Turn summaries, bounded context, and time/token metrics already present in the local log. Search text, favorites, and interaction state are not sent to the model, telemetry, or third parties.

dsh-codex-timeline README · Development and validation：```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm run check
pnpm pack --pack-destination artifacts
```

`scripts/verify-dist.mjs` prevents the old Conversation copy, custom navigation seat, Portal, private runtime dependencies, or local machine paths from re-entering the package. It also verifies the DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 slot, session API, settings, and branch-anchor contracts.

dsh-codex-timeline README · License：[MIT](LICENSE). This release no longer redistributes the official Conversation or `TurnNavigator`; see [NOTICE](NOTICE) for interoperability and attribution details.

dsh-codex-timeline README · DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 compatibility update (2026-09-29)：Supports DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` and retains compatibility declarations for `0.1.7-rc.1` / `0.1.7-rc.2`. Host packages are optional peers, not production dependencies, preventing stale core packages from being installed into the profile. Restart DSH after upgrading. Future host versions require compatibility validation.
